posts.name: LightningRod
posts.cooked:
So me and some pals were playing some very random games and the idea of some characters we wish were on a super hero team or on a different team came up. I was wondering if you guys have any of these. If you do post your reasons why, whether story, or play style, or maybe you just ship two certain time travelers. I look foreword to your thoughts.

 

my wishful team ups include

 

Prime Warden Ra: I know WHY this one isn't a thing but I just love the idea of Ra joining a team and starting to act a little more friendly towards people and maybe having some bonding moments to lessen conflict with Fanatic. plus it would mean EXTREEEME RA! Just imagine how amazing it would be!

 

Southwest Sentinels Unity: Not being an official member of the Freedom Five she decides to cut her teeth with the Southwest Sentinels. I think it would be interesting to see her working with a smaller scale team and interacting with the sentinels as she does with the freedom five. I could see her watching Godzilla movies with Idealist or tinkering with Writhe.

 

Dark Watch Wraith: I think it would be cool for her to be the part time master detective for the Dark Watch. Maybe they request some help in solving a case and she finds a sense of camaraderie to what she used to be working the streets for JUSTICE! Plus I could see some interesting dialogue between the efficient and brilliant Wraith dealing with the super positive but unlucky Setback.
